basic_details.job_title: MSEDCL Superintending Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 11 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Ltd. (MSEDCL, Mahavitaran) has 11 vacancies for the senior-level post of Superintending Engineer (Dist.) under MSEDCL Advertisement No. 04/2026. Applications in the prescribed format, with a Demand Draft and attested certificates, must reach the Asst. General Manager (HR-RC), Recruitment Cell, MSEDCL, Bandra (East), Mumbai on or before 04 December 2026 by Speed Post, Registered Post, courier or by hand.

age_limit.details: Upper age limit: 45 years as on 18/11/2026. Relaxable by 5 years for backward class candidates who apply against posts reserved for backward class. Upper age limit for employees working in MSEDCL (departmental candidates) is 57 years. Reserved category candidates who apply against Open Category are treated as Open candidates and get no age or fee relaxation. Date of birth as per the Secondary School Certificate (SSC) must be given in the application.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application to this address so that it reaches on or before 04 December 2026: Asst. General Manager (HR-RC) RECRUITMENT CELL, MSEDCL, 4th Floor, Prakashgad, Bandra (East), Mumbai - 400051. Applications received after the due date will not be entertained, and the company is not responsible for postal delay. If a candidate applies more than once, the last (latest) application will be considered. No correction is allowed after final submission.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: MSEDCL has 11 posts of Superintending Engineer (Dist.). The notice says the number of vacancies and the reservation for Backward Classes and horizontal reservation are provisional and likely to change. One post is reserved for Persons with Disability (OA/OL/OAL/Dwarfism/Acid Attack Victim). The physical requirements for the post are sitting, standing, walking, manipulation of fingers, reading and writing, seeing, hearing, communication and working on PC. Only persons with not less than 40% disability get the benefit of this reservation. Qualification: Bachelors Degree in Electrical Engineering/ Technology, from a University or Institute in India established or incorporated under a Central Act or a State Act, or a qualification recognised as equivalent. Experience: 12 years of post-qualification experience in Power Sector, including at least 5 years in the area of Power Distribution at the level of Additional Executive Engineer and above, out of which at least 1 (One) year in the position of Executive Engineer (Dist.). OR: 12 years of post-qualification experience in Power Sector, out of which at least 2 years in the position of Executive Engineer (Dist.) in power distribution. Departmental (MSEDCL) candidates with a Degree in Engineering/ Technology in any other discipline who meet the experience conditions will be considered under direct recruitment, competing with other candidates. Experience counts only after acquiring the essential qualification. Equivalency of outside candidates is decided on gross emoluments drawn (other than perks) and job responsibilities. Qualification and experience are counted as on 18/11/2026. Knowledge of Marathi is required: an SSC Board or university certificate showing a pass in Secondary School Certificate, Matric or higher examination with Marathi, OR a certificate from a Professor of Marathi of a college/institute affiliated to a recognised university, countersigned by its Principal, that the candidate can read, write and speak Marathi fluently. Upper age limit: 45 years as on 18/11/2026. Relaxable by 5 years for backward class candidates who apply against posts reserved for backward class. Upper age limit for employees working in MSEDCL (departmental candidates) is 57 years. Reserved category candidates who apply against Open Category are treated as Open candidates and get no age or fee relaxation. Date of birth as per the Secondary School Certificate (SSC) must be given in the application. Selected candidates are entitled to DA, HRA, Medical Benefit, Leave Encashment, CPF and Gratuity etc. as per the Rules of the Company. Statutory deductions are as per the rules. content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application form in the given format, with photograph and signature pasted. Demand Draft for the application fee. Self-attested copies of certificates in support of age, caste, caste validity certificate, qualifications and experience. Non-Creamy Layer Certificate, where applicable. Medical Certificate from the appropriate Medical Board (disability certificate) for PwD candidates. No Objection Certificate, for outside candidates working in a Govt. / Semi Govt. Undertaking.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are shortlisted for the Assessment Centre Process on the basis of qualification, experience, job responsibility, APR etc. In case of higher response, management reserves the right to conduct a screening exercise. Assessment Centre: may involve In-Basket Writing and In-Basket Interaction Exercise, Presentation Writing and Presentation Making Exercise, Group Discussion Exercise and Case Discussion Exercise. Marks obtained (excluding interview) are converted into 100%. Open category candidates (or those applying against OPEN) scoring less than 40%, and SC, ST, NT-C, SEBC, OBC candidates scoring less than 30%, will not be considered for the Personal Interview. Personal Interview: candidates are shortlisted in the ratio of 1:3 of the advertised posts, based on performance in group discussion, presentation and in-basket exercises. Group Discussion and in-basket exercise are held at Mumbai at the candidates' own cost. The method of shortlisting and selection is at the absolute discretion of the company. Selection of departmental candidates is subject to verification of disciplinary actions and service records. The list of shortlisted applicants will be available on www.mahadiscom.in , and call letters will be sent only by email to the address given in the form.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MSEDCL Recruitment 2026 for Superintending Engineer (Dist.)?
faq.answer: There are 11 provisional vacancies: SC 02, ST 02, NT-C 01, SEBC 01 and OPEN 05, with 04 posts for women and 01 for Persons with Disability.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the MSEDCL Recruitment Cell, Bandra (East), Mumbai on or before 04 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for MSEDCL Superintending Engineer (Dist.)?
faq.answer: A Bachelors Degree in Electrical Engineering/ Technology with 12 years of post-qualification Power Sector experience, including the specified Power Distribution experience as Additional Executive Engineer and above or as Executive Engineer (Dist.).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on 18/11/2026, relaxable by 5 years for backward class candidates applying against reserved posts; for MSEDCL employees it is 57 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of MSEDCL Superintending Engineer (Dist.)?
faq.answer: The pay scale is Rs. 109935 - 4740 - 133635 - 5245 - 243780, with DA, HRA, Medical Benefit, Leave Encashment, CPF and Gratuity etc. as per company rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.708/- for Open category and Rs. 354/- for reserved category, paid by Demand Draft; candidates claiming PwD reservation are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for MSEDCL Superintending Engineer (Dist.)?
faq.answer: Send the prescribed application form with the Demand Draft and certificate copies by Speed / Registered Post, courier or by hand to the Asst. General Manager (HR-RC) Recruitment Cell, MSEDCL, 4th Floor, Prakashgad, Bandra (East), Mumbai - 400051.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Shortlisting, an Assessment Centre Process with in-basket, presentation, group discussion and case discussion exercises, and a Personal Interview for candidates shortlisted in the ratio of 1:3.

faq.question: Q9. Is there a service bond for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates other than departmental employees must execute a Surety Bond of Rs.1 lakh to serve MSEDCL for 3 years.

faq.question: Q10. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: Write "MSEDCL ADVT. NO. 04/2026: APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF SUPERENTENDING ENGINEER (DIST.), MSEDCL" on top of the envelope.
